name: Psylocke

abilityDetails.Power Lock: Hedefin herhangi bir yolla güç kazanmasını engeller.
abilityDetails.Power Gain: Güç barlarını anlık veya zamanla doldurur.
abilityDetails.Power Burn: Hedeften belirli miktarda güç alır, ardından alınan güçle orantılı doğrudan hasar verir.
abilityDetails.Reduce Defensive AA: Savunma yetenek doğruluğunu belirtilen güçte azaltır.

howToPlay: Psylocke için oynanış rehberi: Özel saldırılarını kullanarak rakiplerini alt edin. Komboları düzgün zamanlayarak siper alın.
bestUse: Bu şampiyon genel maceralarda ve Mutant sınıfı avantajı olan yollarda en iyi performansı gösterir.
signatureAbility:
Psi-feedback
Psylocke's psionically empowered strikes can disrupt her opponent's nervous system reducing her opponent's Defensive Ability Accuracy by [45 - 75]% when they have 0 Power.
Gain up to [964.29] bonus Critical Damage Rating the lower your opponent's current Power.

abilitySections.title: All Attacks
content: Gain 25% less Power from striking your opponent.

abilitySections.title: Passive
content: Gain up to [1,500] bonus Critical Damage Rating the lower your opponent's current Power.

abilitySections.title: Psi-charge - Passive
content: Your opponent doesn't gain Power when struck, if they have 0 Power, and Psylocke has at least 1 Psi-charge.
Every 5 hits Psylocke lands on an Opponent with 0 Power, she gains a Psi-Charge.
Each time her Opponent fills a bar of Power, Psylocke gains a Psi-charge.
Each time Psylocke is struck by an opponent they consume a Psi-Charge instantly gaining up to 50% additional Power, gaining more Power the longer it's been since they last gained power.

abilitySections.title: Heavy Attacks
content: This attack consumes all Psi-Charges, dealing [2,973.75] Energy Damage per charge consumed.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1
content: Depletes up to 25% of the target's max Power.
If this attack causes your opponent's Power to be reduced over a Special Attack bar threshold, Psylocke will Gain Power until she reaches 1 Bar of Power over 0.25 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: 100% chance to Power Lock, severing the target's flow of Power for 6 seconds.
If this attack hits, Psylocke has a 100% chance to consume 1 Psi-charge, and gain 34% Power over 0.25 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3
content: 100% chance to Power Lock, severing the target's flow of Power for 10 seconds.
Burns 20% of your Target's Power for each Psi-charge consumed. Causing Direct Damage based on the amount Burned.
If this attack reduces your opponent to 0 Power, it Stuns them for 5.5 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Signature Ability - Psi-feedback
content: Psylocke's psionically empowered strikes can disrupt her opponent's nervous system reducing her opponent's Defensive Ability Accuracy by [45 - 75]% when they have 0 Power.
Gain up to [964.29] bonus Critical Damage Rating the lower your opponent's current Power.
